龙大胆顺着她的手势看去，总算是在一片绿树掩映之中，看到了一片黑色的屋顶。远处有一条歪歪斜斜的石板路，曲折地通往村庄。树木郁郁葱葱，而鳞次栉比的屋顶一起在微微的雾气之中，若隐若现，恍然如同仙境。

第二天，不用说，秋秋在寨门口，拉着平板车，激动地等了一夜。

宇宙演化出生物，好处众多，最简单的一点，就是以后再也不会为了吃的东西，而伤脑筋，自给自足，就是这片星空修士的特色。

可是，消息还是穿了出去，尽管红狐是保密了，但是一些爱嚼舌头的人最终还是没能保住自己的秘密。

“他纵然走了也翻不出什么浪头了，毕竟这漕帮他本来能控制的地方也不过三分之一，所以我们进入后这漕帮也是更加分崩离析了，这桑璞巡纵然有一点想回来了，但是他会有助手手下吗？”李长生也是分析道。

“周天，你滚。”也不知道是哪里来的力气，北辰凌雨体内的灵力忽然像是暴动了一般，竟让她挣扎逃脱了周天的魔爪。

“也好，那就请龙医生去准备。我在这里静候龙医生的消息。”罗先生点点头。

“好了，我们不去想这些事情可好？”方潇说着也是把苏忧怜往屋里推。

黎东咬紧牙关全力控制诸天大印，在诸天大印的帮助下，黎东的肉身这才得到了一丁点的喘息之机，者字秘不断地恢复，但是依旧是被空间风暴撕裂。不过情况比之前好了点。

说完之后黎东也是摇了摇头，然后离开了。随后黎东来到了大厅之中，也听闻了兽潮的事情，听到之后，黎东也是脸色发白，幸好紫云城没有被攻击否则，紫云城可就消失了，直到现在黎东都感觉一阵后怕。

“哎！竟然会发生这样的事情，幸好没有出什么大的乱子。”吃饭的时候，张母很感慨的说道。

“兄长和徐庶在这里抵挡，筑起土城，无论什么情况都要问过徐庶再下决定。”庞统嘱咐道。

其中还有一部人是因为其他的一些原因，跟着他们出来的，不过，不管怎么来说，大家选择了出来，都是有原因的。

Long boldly followed her gesture and finally saw a black roof among the green trees.There is a crooked stone road in the distance, leading to the village in a zigzag way.The trees are lush and green, and the rows of roofs are looming in the slight mist, suddenly like a fairyland.

The next day, needless to say, Qiuqiu pulled a flatbed truck at the gate of the village and waited excitedly all night.

There are many benefits to the evolution of living things in the universe. The simplest one is that they will no longer have to worry about food to eat. They are self-sufficient. This is the characteristic of the monks in this starry sky.

However, the news still got out. Although Red Fox kept it a secret, some people who liked to gossip failed to keep their secrets in the end.

"Even if he leaves, he won't be able to make any trouble. After all, he could only control one-third of the Cao Gang, so after we entered, the Cao Gang fell apart even more. Even if Sang Puxun wants to come back, will he have assistants?" Li Changsheng also analyzed.

"Zhou Tian, ​​get out." I don't know where the strength came from, but the spiritual power in Beichen Lingyu's body suddenly seemed to be rioting, and she actually struggled to escape Zhou Tian's clutches.

"Okay, then ask Dr. Long to prepare. I'll wait here for news from Dr. Long." Mr. Luo nodded.

"Okay, how about we not think about these things?" Fang Xiao said and pushed Su Youlian into the room.

Li Dong gritted his teeth and tried his best to control the Great Seal of the Heavens. With the help of the Great Seal of the Heavens, Li Dong's physical body got a little bit of breathing space. The secretaries continued to recover, but they were still torn apart by the space storm.But the situation is better than before.

After speaking, Li Dong also shook his head and left.Then Li Dong came to the hall and heard about the beast tide. After hearing this, Li Dong also turned pale. Fortunately, Ziyun City was not attacked. Otherwise, Ziyun City would have disappeared. Even now, Li Dong feels scared.

"Hey! Such a thing happened. Fortunately, there was no big trouble." During the meal, Zhang's mother said with emotion.

"Brother and Xu Shu are here to resist and build an earthen city. No matter what the situation is, we must ask Xu Shu before making a decision." Pang Tong instructed.

There are also some people who came out with them due to other reasons, but no matter what, there is a reason why everyone chose to come out.
